entries.title: India AI Rules: What Is Law and What Is Expected?
entries.description: India’s 2026 IT Rules cover specified synthetic media. Here is what is in force, how the takedown clocks differ, and what remains only an expectation.

entries.title: GitHub Octoverse 2026: Agents Start 40% of PRs
entries.description: GitHub says agents started over 40% of September PRs. What the signal measures, misses, and how teams can track review outcomes.

entries.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Who Can Test It—and What Scores Show
entries.description: Google will gate Gemini 4 Carbon to cyber defenders first. We separate access claims, benchmark methods, independent results and missing safety documents.

entries.title: Anthropic S-1: Who Owns It—and Who Controls the Board?
entries.description: Anthropic’s S-1 separates public economic rights from founder voting power and Trust board control. We explain the proposed classes and reported loss.

entries.title: Hyperscaler CapEx: Why 2026 Figures Don’t Add Cleanly
entries.description: Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report different capital-spending figures. We explain the mismatched periods, lease bases and AI-only gaps.

entries.title: OpenAI’s Offline Training Policy Starts With an Incident
entries.description: OpenAI says a DNS error enabled limited internet access during training. We explain the timeline, offline controls and what remains unconfirmed.

entries.title: C-DAC’s 10,000-Unit Tender: Not a Deployment Count
entries.description: C-DAC seeks AI compute providers in two stages. The 10,000-unit figure is a tender requirement, not deployed capacity or a completed purchase.

entries.title: EU AI Act Deadlines Are Not One Deadline
entries.description: A practical guide to the AI Act's separate 2026, 2027 and 2028 dates, including Article 50 transitions and high-risk system categories.

entries.title: Workforce Plans Do Not Prove AI Caused the Cuts
entries.description: Microsoft announced voluntary exits; the Dutch government set a multi-year FTE target. Neither official source attributes job losses to AI.

entries.title: AI Agents Need Access, Not Your Password
entries.description: Credential brokers, separate identities and local AI each address different boundaries—not every security risk in an agent workflow.
